name: Details Finding
description: The source-specific record behind a generic finding. The finding (compliance_core__compliance_finding) is what rules, panels and cross-plugin queries traverse; the detail is what a human reads when they open one — for a code scanning alert, the rule, its severities, the location and the dismissal. Exactly one detail per finding, and the finding's asset placement is NOT here: that is compliance_core's CARRIES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING from the repository or workflow. Nor is this evidence — CITES_COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE is a different claim (something that SUPPORTS a verdict); the detail IS the observation the finding was minted from. Dependabot and secret-scanning detail nodes will be appended to `sources` as they land; the finding shape does not change.
